title: Orders are taken by phone
subtitle: Call +39 0771 460651 during opening hours. The shop answers, not a call centre. We speak [[LINGUE_AL_BANCO]].

fresh.title: Fresh items are ordered the day before
text: Calzoncini, potato frittatine, focaccine, tielle and pizzette are baked each day in the quantity ordered, plus a little extra. Simple rule: **call by [[ORA_LIMITE]], collect tomorrow at the time you choose**. Baking times: [[ORARI_SFORNATE]]. If something has sold out, the counter will set it aside for you for the next day.

what.title: What you can order
text: Whole tielle, cakes, maritozzi, yeast-free bread, trays of pizzette and savoury pastries, gift baskets. Suggested notice: [[ANTICIPO]]; for Christmas and Easter, by the dates on the seasonal price list [[LINK]].

holidays.title: Holidays
text: Every year we prepare a holiday price list: Christmas (sciuscelle, mostaccioli, baskets), Carnival and St Joseph's Day (zeppole), Easter (pigna, casatiello). You'll find it in the shop and below.

business.title: Bars, restaurants, B&Bs and hotels
text: We supply bread, pizzette, croissants and tielle to businesses in Gaeta and the Gulf, delivered [[DELIVERY TIME: to confirm]]. Call for a price list and a trial order.

boats.title: Boats
text: Moored in Gaeta? Bread, pizzette and tielle for the galley, ordered by [[CUT-OFF TIME: to confirm]] for the next day, ready at the time you choose.

shipping.title: Shipping
text: [[If active: "We ship wine ring biscuits, tozzetti, taralli and vacuum-packed tielle within Italy: call for the bakery box."]]
[[If not: "We don't ship yet: for now everything travels in your suitcase. Ask at the counter for the suitcase pack."]]
